syntax_cache.scope: Single-threaded finite attempt; entries retain immutable payloads until context release.

caller_process.scope: One observer invocation; no retry. Wall includes observer startup and final serialization, nested with its child window.

outer_process.measurement_scope: Observer run entry through post-run input/output checks; excludes interpreter/import startup, source preparation, root review and final receipt serialization. Child wall is nested, not additive. Not lifetime cost.
outer_process.scope: Once-only training opportunity recording; no native admission, serving utility, held-out result or novelty follows.

previous_costs.scope: Earlier disjoint attempt retained; nested intervals must not be summed as independent totals.

caller_process.measurement_scope: One observer Popen through wait4 and log closure; includes nested child work. Setup, final custody and receipt serialization excluded. No automatic retry; no lifetime-cost claim.

outer_process.measurement_scope: Observer run entry through post-run input/output checks; excludes interpreter/import startup, source preparation, root review and final receipt serialization. Child wall is nested, not additive. Not lifetime cost.
outer_process.scope: Once-only retained screening recording; no native admission, acquisition, serving utility, held-out result or novelty follows.

prior_screen_costs.scope: Earlier disjoint screening attempt retained. Its caller/outer/driver windows are nested, not additive. Original opportunity costs remain separate.
